assertion_independence: No added assertion was found tautological under the stated two-sides-move-together rule. Fixture ids and literals are compared with independently read ledger membership, persisted JSON, actual pointer existence, serialized size or observed calls. Mock-based evidence transport checks establish transport only; actual promotion and refusal are covered by the integration cases.

assertion_review.test_a_dry_run_returns_guard_evidence_wi: Writing normal completion receipts during dry-run breaks the empty glob; performing promotion breaks pointer survival; omitting dry_run breaks its literal flag assertion.
assertion_review.test_a_held_report_still_names_the_coord: Filtering before consulting the hold loses the single row; forgetting hold text or replacing release by completion breaks its literal checks.
assertion_review.test_a_large_pretty_batch_keeps_its_repl: Removing the batch fallback exceeds 2000 bytes; omitting a member breaks fixed expected count and stored member-set checks; omitting per-run persistence breaks file checks.
assertion_review.test_a_long_run_name_keeps_its_condition: Repeating a full observe command or unbounded evidence can exceed 400; losing the gate prefix breaks the reason assertion; a broken evidence action fails the command or omits test_guard from its actual output.
assertion_review.test_a_missing_runs_receipt_does_not_cre: Writing a receipt under a newly created run directory breaks the second absence assertion; misclassifying a missing run breaks ok=False or the run-specific guards assertion; failing to preserve the refusal breaks independently opened record content.
assertion_review.test_a_nested_landing_refusal_keeps_its_: Losing the nested refusal breaks the nonzero exit or named test_guard condition; not storing full evidence breaks receipt existence.
assertion_review.test_a_ready_report_is_left_to_its_exist: Returning the old review duty breaks the empty list; deleting a pointer during this read breaks pointer existence; READY verifies this is the eligible control population.
assertion_review.test_a_refused_member_does_not_skip_the_: Removing gate validation makes the first member successful and deletes its pointer; aborting at the first refusal leaves the valid pointer; either regression breaks the exit/ok vector and pointer assertions; skipping receipt persistence breaks file-existence checks.
assertion_review.test_a_single_reply_keeps_large_evidence: Returning 60000 characters inline breaks the byte limit; dropping the full evidence or writing the wrong record breaks an independent file read against the fixed evidence literal.
assertion_review.test_automatic_delivery_reuses_the_head_: Restoring the wrapper head reread appends the run twice and breaks the exact read sequence; failing to filter the eligible delivery breaks is None.
assertion_review.test_complete_help_names_repeated_run_co: Restoring the old option/help breaks both help substrings or the independent Click option.multiple introspection.
assertion_review.test_escaped_condition_text_stays_inside: Counting raw characters instead of escaped JSON restores the recorded 742-character row; removing the reason prefix breaks convergence identification.
assertion_review.test_one_confirmation_promotes_both_runs: Restoring last-value-wins processes only the second run, so independent ledger membership and reply run membership fail; returning the full outcome breaks the byte limit; not writing the receipt or not promoting it breaks independent file contents, recorded gate and pointer deletion checks.
assertion_review.test_several_runs_refuse_evidence_that_c: Accepting one shared commit across members breaks nonzero exit, refusal wording and untouched pointer assertions.
assertion_review.test_the_default_batch_requests_both_pro: Executing synchronously populates calls; ignoring a repeated run breaks returned membership and independently read promotion requests; wrong request state breaks phase assertions.
assertion_review.test_the_drain_keeps_the_full_receipt_fo: Applying the public compact projection to the internal COMMAND_REPLY sink removes record.gate or pointer_removed and breaks direct internal receipt reads.
assertion_review.test_the_tool_callback_returns_the_same_: Routing the tool sink past the compact adapter returns large evidence inline and breaks the byte limit; lost capture breaks ok or independently opened evidence.
assertion_review.test_twelve_deliveries_leave_three_bound: Restoring unconditional delivered duties yields twelve rather than three ids; retaining full evidence or removing JSON-aware trimming breaks the 400-character assertion; losing the failure condition, observe action or completion command breaks their literal assertions; mutating the pointer instead of projecting it breaks the stored refusal assertion.
assertion_review.test_two_of_three_manual_decisions_land_: Ignoring the plan manual choice breaks the REFUSED setup and visible-id assertions; dropping either repeated run breaks the returned member set or receipt pointer_removed checks; promoting automatic neighbors or the third manual report breaks untouched-pointer and remaining-row assertions; oversized output breaks both explicit bounds.
